name: airports
title: Airports with country, region and runway summary (OurAirports)
description: Every airport, heliport, seaplane base and balloonport in OurAirports (86,094 rows, including closed sites), joined to its country and region names and summarised with its runways: total runway count, open runway count and longest open runway. Built by joining four OurAirports tables (airports, countries, regions, runways) with every key and foreign key checked. Missing values are empty cells. Note: the literal value NA is data, not missing — continent NA is North America and iso_country NA is Namibia. Snapshot taken 2026-09-18; rebuilt offline by build.ts from the archived CSVs.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OurAirports internal airport id (stable).

fields.name: ident
fields.description: OurAirports identifier: the ICAO code where one exists, otherwise a local or OurAirports-assigned code.

fields.name: type
fields.description: One of large_airport, medium_airport, small_airport, heliport, seaplane_base, balloonport, closed.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Official airport name.

fields.name: latitude_deg
fields.description: Latitude, decimal degrees (WGS84).

fields.name: longitude_deg
fields.description: Longitude, decimal degrees (WGS84).

fields.name: elevation_ft
fields.description: Elevation above mean sea level, feet; empty where unknown.

fields.name: continent
fields.description: Continent code: AF, AN, AS, EU, NA (North America — not missing), OC, SA.

fields.name: iso_country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (NA = Namibia — not missing).

fields.name: country_name
fields.description: Country name, joined from OurAirports countries.csv on iso_country.

fields.name: iso_region
fields.description: Region code (ISO 3166-2 where available, otherwise an OurAirports code).

fields.name: region_name
fields.description: Region name, joined from OurAirports regions.csv on iso_region.

fields.name: municipality
fields.description: Primary municipality served; empty where not given.

fields.name: scheduled_service
fields.description: true if the airport currently has scheduled airline service.

fields.name: icao_code
fields.description: ICAO code; empty where none.

fields.name: iata_code
fields.description: IATA code; empty where none.

fields.name: gps_code
fields.description: Code used in GPS databases; empty where none.

fields.name: local_code
fields.description: Local country code (e.g. FAA LID in the US); empty where none.

fields.name: runway_count
fields.description: Runways listed for this airport in runways.csv, including closed ones (helipads count as runways at heliports). 0 when none are listed.

fields.name: open_runway_count
fields.description: Runways not marked closed.

fields.name: longest_open_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest open runway length, feet. Empty when there is no open runway or no open runway has a recorded length.
